contracts.source: Vantage Data Centers press release: Vantage and Heron Power Electronics Announce Gigawatt-Scale (10-21-2026)
contracts.signal: Vantage and Heron Power Electronics announced a strategic, gigawatt-scale manufacturing capacity agreement: Vantage has secured over 1GW of manufacturing capacity of Heron Link, Heron's solid-state transformer (SST), to deploy in its hyperscale data center campuses for AI and cloud customers. Heron Link converts medium-voltage grid power directly to 800 VDC with integrated energy storage, reducing conversion stages between grid and rack, and targets more than 98.5% efficiency from medium voltage to 800 VDC. Heron founder and CEO Drew Baglino: deploying more than a gigawatt of Heron Links in Vantage data centers will move 800 VDC from a reference architecture concept to a repeatable, deployed platform.
contracts.units: over 1GW of manufacturing capacity of Heron Link

players.product: hyperscale AI data-center campuses - Lighthouse (Port Washington, WI; four data centers, close to 1 GW of AI capacity for Oracle / OpenAI Stargate) and CWL1 (South Wales, leased to Nebius) - with dedicated on-site power partnerships (Liberty Energy, VoltaGrid)
